title: Time and Days of the Week

001: Haoran, what time is it now?
It's three thirty in the afternoon.
Didn't we agree to meet at four?
Right, there's still half an hour.
Then let's go grab a cup of coffee first.
002: Tingting, what day is it today?
That's right, do you have any plans?
Tomorrow afternoon I have to go to class.
Me too, let's go together then.
003: Zixuan, what time do you get up in the morning?
I usually get up at seven.
That early? Do you do that on weekends too?
On weekends I get up a bit later, around eight thirty.
004: Jingyi, what time do you usually go to bed at night?
I usually go to sleep around eleven.
That's not too late. I often don't go to bed until twelve.
Going to bed too late is bad for your health.
You're right, I should change that.
005: Tianyou, are you free Friday evening?
Friday evening? I don't have any plans yet.
I want to go see a movie. Do you want to come along?
Sure, what time does it start?
No problem, let's meet at seven.
006: Jiaqi, how much time do you spend studying every day?
Do you study in the morning or in the afternoon?
I'm used to studying in the afternoon.
Is your mind sharper in the afternoon?
Yeah, I feel more productive in the afternoon.
007: Haoran, do you remember what time our class is?
I remember it's at nine in the morning.
Then we need to get to the classroom early.
Right, we should get there at eight forty-five.
Okay, I'll leave home a bit earlier tomorrow.
Same for me, see you tomorrow.
008: Tingting, what do you usually do on weekends?
I go to the gym on Saturday mornings.
On Sunday I usually rest at home.
That's nice. I want to get some exercise too.
009: Zixuan, do you know what month it is now?
Yeah, half a year has passed in the blink of an eye.
Do you have any plans for summer vacation?
I plan to go back to my hometown and stay for a while.
010: Jingyi, what time did you get home yesterday?
I got home at eight thirty yesterday.
That early? I didn't get back until ten.
What did you go do yesterday?
I went out to eat with some friends.
That sounds nice. As long as you had fun.
